summary: A source-grounded Velori exercise with explicit state preservation and a complete native handoff.

expectedEntries.text: Replaced the Data Pipeline Studio assignment and Simple Design System reference with Velori: a preserved configurator, one Review configuration extension, and a portable React sample.
expectedEntries.rationale: One supplied product now carries the source, state, implementation and native Figma checks through the capstone.

expectedEntries.text: Added source definition and conflict records, CSS and prop inventories, controlled import scope, asset hashes recorded before validation, fidelity checks of ten elements, and named correction fixtures followed by a second generation.
expectedEntries.rationale: Readers can resolve source disagreements and verify reuse before introducing the review screen.

expectedEntries.text: Specified retention of all four configuration values, keyboard and return focus, image recovery, narrow layouts, and native Figma component/variable correspondence. Detail photographs remain Chalk, and prototype visits are distinguished from browser reload persistence.
expectedEntries.rationale: These contracts expose state loss and unsupported claims of parity between tools.

expectedEntries.text: Corrected the local Code handoff to Copy prompt and authenticated source reads. Truncated binaries require a full native archive; captured bytes stay private and unchanged, host adaptations are disclosed, and each new packet is validated independently.
expectedEntries.rationale: Complete source and dependency bytes are required before executable handoff acceptance.
